## Interpretation -> modeling decisions (Phase 1 conclusions)
1. Blend weight prior w ~= 0.5 (std betas 0.305 pts / 0.312 xG_all for next-season pts). xg_pct_all
   slightly out-predicts xg_pct_5v5_adj one season ahead (0.549 vs 0.523) - special teams are real
   skill; use all-situations xG, keep 5v5 as robustness check.
2. Two-ahead shrinkage: use directly-estimated 2-lag slope (~0.38 in pts% space; ~0.75x the 1-lag),
   NOT phi^2 (0.26) - quality has a persistent component beyond AR(1).
3. sh%/sv% YoY r ~= 0.006 -> PDO is luck; regression via MOV-Elo + xG blend handles it.
4. OT submodel: p(reach OT) ~= 0.225 (3v3 era), skill slope compressed to ~0.40 of regulation,
   home edge in OT ~= 51%; SO share of past-regulation games ~= 0.34.
5. HFA: calibrate to recent home win% ~= 53.5-54% (declining era).
6. Calibration targets: mean pts/82 ~= 91.3 (translates to ~93.5-94/84g); recent sd(pts/82) ~= 15-17
   (2021/2022 unbalanced-schedule seasons inflate; weigh 2023-2026).
7. Expansion rating prior irrelevant for 2027-28 (32 teams confirmed); backtest uses 1470 for
   VGK/SEA entries with a note (VGK lesson: expansion priors are high-variance).

## Phase 3 results (frozen 2026-08-12)
PARAMS: K=6, H=35, phi_s=0.7, w=0.6 (Elo) / 0.4 (xG_all), phi1=0.85, phi2=0.75, sigma1=30, sigma2=40 Elo.
- Stage A plateau flat (ll 0.67680 best vs 0.67707 at 10th pct) -> not overfit to grid. K=6 matches 538's NHL Elo.
- Validation 2018-2026 (frozen, one pass):
  one-ahead MAE/82: model 10.54 | regressed-prior 11.03 | uniform 13.24 | raw 12.50 (model best 7/9 seasons)
  two-ahead MAE/82: model 11.57 | regressed-prior 11.90 | uniform 13.24 | raw 14.02
  playoff Brier: 0.195 (h1), 0.208 (h2) vs 0.25 constant; binned calibration good, slight tail compression.
  in-season log loss 0.6691 vs 0.6900 constant-home.
- Trajectory term NULL: gamma=0 optimal on train two-ahead (9.910 at 0 vs 9.926-9.988 elsewhere). Dropped.
- 2025-26 was a hard season for everyone (uniform beat all skill models; spearman 0.14) - parity year;
  relevant caveat for 2027-28: league spread is compressing.

## v2 (pieces-driven) findings — 2026-08-13
Player EDA:
- Goalie talent (GSAx/shot) stabilization n0 ~ 5,000 shots; per-goalie projection beats
  predict-league-average by ~9% wMSE (goalies are voodoo, but not pure noise).
- Consistency C (DerSimonian-Laird tau2 ratio): Shesterkin 0.57 / Hellebuyck 0.61 steady elite;
  one-great-season profiles >1.3. C quantiles [0.57, 1.0, 1.66].
- Age curves (player FE, TOI-weighted): F peak 27 (-0.30 pts60 by 32, -0.65 by 36), D flatter.
  Delta-method cross-check sign-agrees.
Stage T (train <=2017): h1 base(elo+xg) 9.53 vs full 9.86 (pieces add noise at h1 in-train);
  h2 base 10.63 vs R2 10.47 (pieces help decay). lambda=64/32. sigma_c 40/50.
  Heteroscedastic goalie sigma: prereg coverage test -> DROPPED (no tertile improvement).
Overlay mechanism: rho=0.743 (t~3.3) but placebo -0.528 -> BLOCKED (buyers are selected
  underperformers; mean reversion confound). Movers valued+published, 0 Elo applied.
Confirm (2018-2021, prereg gate): R3 8.78 / R2 8.74 / v1 9.17 -> R3 adopted.
Final (2022-2026, single run): h1 v2 11.12 vs v1 10.91 vs regressed 11.18; h2 v2 12.15 / v1 11.93.
VERDICT: v2 ~ v1 on accuracy (inside noise both directions); v2 adds attribution, goalie/age/
player sheets, tested nulls. 2026 parity season: uniform beats all skill models (again).
